environment_findings.evidence: pyproject pins NumPy/Jieba/tqdm/Transformers but leaves datasets, accelerate, tokenizers, rouge, rouge_score, and others unpinned
freeze_requirements contains machine-local conda file URLs and an editable git+ssh AdaKV dependency
freeze_requirements points the editable AdaKV package to 67a0fc2729800c3d902225f359e0b50f9202556b rather than audited repository revision 04497abac4c1a58426f3daf1014578990e225cc5
pyproject/freeze pin Transformers 4.44.2, while check_version declares only versions containing 4.37 as tested and otherwise warns rather than fails
make i builds csrc with python build.py install and then performs editable pip installation

runtime_findings.evidence: entry functions replace global Llama/Mistral FlashAttention forward, model forward, and generation-input methods in Transformers
flattened per-head cache update imports tiny_api_cuda at runtime; source contains TODO interface notes and reports sequence length as one rather than retained length
reference cache selection may repeat KV heads to query-head count before scoring; GQA aggregation mode is a configuration choice of mean or max
config_compress writes window, capacity, pooling, floor, pyramidal, skip, and GQA settings into the loaded model config

evaluation_findings.evidence: LongBench prediction loads tokenizer and model with trust_remote_code=True and no immutable repository revision
datasets are loaded from a user-supplied dataset path/config without a frozen Hub/source revision in the runner
model2path.json must be edited to point to local models
Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA, and all CUDA devices are seeded to 42
the immutable 38-file tree contains no dedicated test directory or test-named source

clean_room_requirements: derive the within-layer allocation equation directly from arXiv:2407.11550v5
write a tiny framework-independent NumPy/Torch reference without importing AdaKV
freeze uniform versus adaptive head budgets, ties, GQA grouping, observation window, and question-aware/agnostic modes
prove retained-budget conservation and mass-bound optimality on exhaustive small cases
compare constituent-complete source recall against retained mass and L1 attention-output error
use separately qualified model/data adapters with network disabled
only then audit an isolated upstream implementation in a disposable environment

decision.next_action: freeze and test the clean-room small-case allocation reference; do not install or execute the upstream package
